name: Grid Scroll Scale Out
description: Sparse image grid where each tile shrinks to nothing from a bottom corner as it scrolls, revealing a fixed centered title behind it, followed by a full-screen text footer panel.
contents: Grid of square image tiles placed on explicit rows and columns
Fixed centered cover title with superscript mark and subtitle
Full-screen footer panel with a paragraph
behavior: Each tile scales down on scroll scrub from a randomly chosen bottom left or bottom right origin
Cover title stays fixed behind the grid while tiles disappear

props.name: coverSubtitle
props.default: 並外れたファッション

props.name: footerBody
props.default: From the dawn of civilisation onwards crowds have always undergone the influence of illusions. It is to the creators of illusions that they have raised more temples, statues, and altars than to any other class of men.

editableByProps: Tile images, rows and columns, grid column count
Cover title, mark, subtitle, size, and footer text
Background, text and footer colors, image contrast
Scroll trigger range, easing, end scale, smooth scroll toggle

needsCodeEdit.change: Use a fixed origin instead of a random bottom corner
needsCodeEdit.where: transformOrigin in the .set(image) call inside the useEffect

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when smoothScroll is on, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Cover title is position fixed and covers the viewport while the component is on the page
Footer panel is a full viewport height block needed for the scroll ending
